title: Account Executive - Portfolio
teaser: Join us as an Account Executive - Portfolio and play a key role in driving growth for Vodafone Germany and Romania. Take ownership of a major market, expand Cisco's Infrastructure Provisioning portfolio, and build lasting relationships. Ideal for experienced sales professionals with a strong background in service provider accounts and fluency in German and English.
description:
Meet The Team

We are hiring for one of the most exciting sales roles in SP EMEA. You are joining the most innovative, energetic, innovative and successful Global Account Team in Europe, Africa and India and Top 5 customer of Cisco. We are growing in double digits and as one of the leading Account Managers in this truly international team covering 17 Markets around the globe, you will be responsible for Vodafone Germany, the biggest Market in Vodafone Group representing 30% of its EBITA and Romania a growing Market.

Join a Winning Team: Drive Growth with Vodafone Germany & Romania!

Are you a driven, ambitious sales professional looking for a role where you can truly make an impact and be rewarded for your success? We're hiring for one of the most exciting sales opportunities in Service Provider (SP) Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), and we want YOU to be a part of it!

Your Impact

This isn't just another sales role; it's a chance to join a top-tier, globally recognized Global Account Team and partner with one of Cisco's Top 5 customers - Vodafone. We're experiencing dynamic double-digit growth, and as a key Account Manager within our energetic and innovative international team (covering 17 markets across Europe, Africa, and India), you'll be at the forefront of this expansion.

You will take ownership of Vodafone Germany, the powerhouse market representing 30% of Vodafone Group's EBITA, and the rapidly growing Romanian market. You'll be instrumental in expanding our Infrastructure Provisioning (IP) transport franchise while also driving growth across a comprehensive portfolio including mobility, enterprise IT, collaboration, Acquisition Integration (AI), observability, and automation.

Why Vodafone is a Game-Changer:

         •        Digital Backbone: Vodafone is a high-octane global telecommunications titan, powering millions across Europe, Africa, and India. They are innovators, constantly pushing the boundaries of connectivity.

         •        Industry Leader: From being the "Connectivity King" with vast mobile and fixed networks to being the "Internet of Things (IoT) Trailblazer" connecting over 150 million devices, Vodafone is shaping the future.

         •        Future-Forward: They are at the cutting edge of Fifth Generation Wireless (5G) deployment and committed to "Purpose-Led Innovation," using technology for sustainability and digital inclusion.

Your Autonomy and Support:

We empower you to lead. You'll have the freedom to develop your own strategies for Germany and Romania, working independently or collaboratively with your teammate, without artificial limitations. You'll report directly to the Director of Vodafone Europe and Group, and you'll be backed by a dedicated global team, including specialized Sales Engineers (SEs), providing you with unparalleled support.

What We're Looking For:

We seek a "hunter" with a proven ability to open doors and a natural talent for building deep, lasting relationships. You are:

         •        Highly Self-Motivated: Driven to develop these significant markets and achieve exceptional results.

         •        Excellent Relationship Skills: Possessing the ability to cultivate and maintain strong relationships to keep and extend key Cisco champions at Vodafone Germany.

         •        Strategic & Politically Savvy: Adept at navigating the complexities of a global account, managing political landscapes, and overcoming challenges.

         •        Entrepreneurial Spirit: You see opportunities and seize them, acting with ownership and a drive for success.

Minimum Qualifications:
 

         •        Minimum 5 years proven experience as an Account Manager with large, complex accounts

         •        Understanding of the Service Provider (SP) market and its dynamics.

         •        Demonstrated success selling Cisco's IP Transport portfolio and other Cisco solutions.

         •        Fluent in German and English.

         •        Willingness to travel.

         •        Familiarity with Cisco's sales processes.

Preferred Qualifications:
 

         •        Entrepreneurial mindset and a proven track record of driving new business.

         •        Exceptional deal-making abilities.

         •        Strong solution-oriented approach to customer engagement.

If you're ready to take on a challenging, rewarding, and high-impact sales role with a leading global player, we want to hear from you! Apply now to join our dynamic team and shape the future of connectivity.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
